requirements.R_SOURCE_TRUST: Package, container, and dependency ingress rejects sources outside the configured allow-lists, including direct file/URL bypasses.
requirements.R_IMMUTABLE_IDENTITY: Admission decisions and cache identity are bound to the exact immutable artifact digest; container tags alone are not sufficient.
requirements.R_SCANNER_EVIDENCE: Scanner outage or unknown vulnerability evidence fails closed instead of being treated as clean.
requirements.R_VULNERABILITY_POLICY: Observed vulnerability severity and container-signature policy produce the configured deterministic allow/deny outcome.
requirements.R_CACHE_FRESHNESS: Cached decisions are reusable only for the same digest, policy generation, scanner DB generation, and unexpired TTL.
requirements.R_EXCEPTION_SCOPE: A vulnerability exception applies only to its exact artifact kind/digest/environment and only before expiry.
requirements.R_PERMIT_BINDING: Every allow permit is integrity protected, short-lived, and bound to the exact artifact, instance, and policy generation.
requirements.R_AUDIT_DURABILITY: Allow, deny, and exception decisions append to durable audit history that survives separate process invocations.
